description: A quoted mixed-case type name and the unquoted name of the same letters are two types, as PostgreSQL keeps them: the enum "Mood" and the enum mood, and the composites "Shapes"."Pair" and "Shapes".pair, each keep their own labels or fields as columns, as :: and CAST results, as array casts, as a parameter typed by a cast, as function parameter and return types, and in a column definition list. An unquoted MOOD folds to mood. A quoted name that spells a built-in in another case is not the built-in: the composite "Point" is apart from the geometric point, which a quoted "point" in lower case still names.
